'''Woz Kaza''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] who was as an [[Ambassador]] for the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] before its [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution]]. He then became a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He negotiated with [[Ileris Tik'kla]] for weapons, but betrayed her. Tik'kla was able to get Kaza's family diverted away from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and walked out of the meeting.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Woz Kaza appears in the opening story in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Desperate Allies]]''.
